answer: A workable design: score token-distribution divergence against the identity's own answer history. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The delta of work and the copper of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a reef to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
